builtOn: Task 80: written by Claude for the MiniLM fallback's comparison (hybrid v2), in the way Saudi students write; no text copied from any development or test set. Each sentence is compared with the student's sentences like the capability's label and description.
rule: Per capability: three Saudi-dialect sentences and two mixed Arabic-English sentences. The fallback keeps the best score over all of a capability's texts.
